Latin word

paulō

paulō (+ comparative)

adverb (the ablative of the measure of difference)

a little (with comparatives): a little more, a little earlier; slightly (more, less, earlier)

In this lexicon

  • a little

    also used · classical · Plaut. Men. 4.3.7: paulō prius (Lewis & Short); Cic. Or. 82: līberius paulō (Lewis & Short)

  • slightly

    also used · classical · Cic. Quinct. 11: paulō minus cōnsīderātus (Lewis & Short); Cic. Or. 82: līberius paulō (Lewis & Short)

  • paulō post: a little later

    classical

  • paulō ante: a little while ago

    classical
